info.name: Evergreen Bank - Firebase REST API
info.description: Firebase Authentication REST and Cloud Firestore REST templates for Evergreen Bank. No Firebase SDK and no Realtime Database. Requests are templates; do not execute placeholder writes or create fake records. See README in the ZIP.

item.name: Sign in with email and password

request.description: Returns idToken, refreshToken and localId. Store these only in the Postman environment for testing.

item.name: Create Auth user (optional - customer registration test)

request.description: Optional test only. This creates an Authentication identity, not a Firestore user profile or KYC record.
